## Sample 02-airflow-etl-modernization
- [ ] CI green (lint, types, tests, coverage gate, gitleaks, image OCR, pdf metadata, images and pdf artifacts)
- [ ] Coverage meets the target in the build prompt
- [ ] README: problem, diagram, one-command run, limits, data sources, delivery line
- [ ] No secrets, no real client or employer data, no contact details, no marketplace or private-repo names or links

- [ ] No AI co-author trailers or "Generated with" lines in commits or PR text
